D5/S3/Quantum/Routing/HannSpatialQram.co.name: D5.S3.Quantum.Routing.HannSpatialQram.correctness
D5/S3/Quantum/Routing/HannSpatialQram.co.signature: theorem correctness : (∀ (n : ℕ) (a : Address n) (b : Qutrit) (k : ℕ), k ≤ n → load n k (loading n a b 0) = loading n a b k) ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ) (a : Address n) (p : Qutrit), transport n (input n (programmed n a n) p) = arrived n a p ∧ ∀ i : Address n, leaf n (transport n (input n (programmed n a n) p)) i = if i = a then p else wait) ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ) (D : Address n → Bool) (a : Address n) (b : Bool), query n D (clean n a b) = clean n a (xor b (D a))) ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ) (D : Address n → Bool), (queryMatrix n D)ᴴ * queryMatrix n D = 1 ∧ queryMatrix n D * (queryMatrix n D)ᴴ = 1 ∧ ∀ ψ : Address n × Bool → ℂ, query
